cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You nodded at Friday. I'll record that you've accepted me as project lead; the minutes need a clear decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only agreed to the meeting date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The date I set. That's acceptance of my timetable. Please don't record the same decision twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll attend, but I'm voting against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll list you as my finance watchdog. Send your objections before Friday so I can put your contribution under my opening report.
